VASSAL.build.module.folder.ModuleSubFold.desc: #344 Tactician Marker should immediately select LBO when location is selected - in SOLITAIRE mode only

#352 Grand Man fixes; gOrders display; single unit ordering
#348 Trial fix to Orders Display (Layer controls moved inline) REVERTED (didn't make a difference)
#349 Fix spurious movement alert icons for movement Tactician cards involving "stop movement" terrain. Separate Stop p/type.
#337 resetOrders explicitly resets badOrders (maybe fixing spurious Stop display?)
#354 square for oppo side not working - relocation unit square GKC to combat assist side bar. Unit command should do via sidebar!
#355 GAC display off card
#356 Prevent interfence with Elan.
#355(a) Separate out Counter Basics context menu Action Button for GAC
#365 Click side icon to display that side's hand now works again (reliably).
#337 isWaiting becomes a local property to prevent wait sign showing (and sometimes persisting) on other players' screens
#358 Unsquare PBEM fixes (loosen restriction in Card Ownership).
#366 deselect block after active movement to mitigate accidental drag risk
#316 Widget-driven Command card play requires interim step for GAC (Take Command)
#358 Unsquare PBEM option provided on unit & combat marker
#348 fix to restore passive piece unorder; disable passive order command unless piece is Moved.
#352 Further fixes for Grand Man movement / order integration
#355 GAC - prevent clickable whilst GAC is possible (drag too susceptible to accidental click)
#352 Fix loss of NB on some movement actions in 015.
#368 GAC - unified GAC end turn that handles Elan and transfers card ownership if need be (PBEM support)
#369 Overhaul of multi-section support within Command Card Orders & Bonus p/type
#370 Solitaire no longer auto-discards if a Guerrilla Action is pending
#334 gOrders reset to zero after Force March p/type auto-orders. Prevents badOrders display on first battle dice roll.
#334 Fix issues that cause LBO to generate bad order state
#373 Cossacks do not get special ability to battle on entering a Forest hex (FAQ reversion to Rules as Written by R.Borg)
#337 Extra check in Orders Display icon surround layer so that gOrders must be non-zero or the icon in wait mode before surround layer displays.
#374 Fix movePath corruption issue for French Horse Artillery in GG00 scenario (fixLoc applied to all PDS)
#157 Optimise canPlay calculation for cards in Decks
#375 TC Marker Basics: Control TC marker movement / advice on correct use
#376 noPlay added to Counter-Attack Play command restriction.
#157 Optimise turn constraints on card play by replacing multiple turnDrawn checks with the justDrawn boolean.
#370 Fix Take Command widget issue where GAC discard mode was inverted for Solitaire.
#377 Terrain hover-aid masked by hex Highlighting piece.
#337 Order error alert icon surround layer fix - Orders Display's surround layer needs to show when badOrders = true.
#370 Force March & Take Command Any should play to Centre if GAC is active.
#355 Make Guerrilla Action counter disappear promptly after defence roll.
#166 Deck setup re-worked - space saving & workaround to Scenario Browser bug (bug possibly fixed in beta13)
#157 GMT Hand Helper data error - justDrawn needed explicit test in attachment other properties field.
#379 First Strike justDrawn needed reset actions as per Tactician cards.
#380 Counter-attack no longer playable at game start.
#382 Check pType not Type to discard Paper strength counter at game start.
#393 Workaround for 383 - add trapIssue383 in Startup / Start Panel and Dealer (Scenario Browser open-over active game fatal error warning)
#393a scenario browser /decks workaround: fix deck test for drawn card (Card Basics & Card Reporting Service)
#384 Obscured Command card restrictions added for Ctrl+F & Alt+T. TODO: Review Tactician card also for Alt+T.
#385 Clear build mode before startup message / diagnostics alert (ghkInitModule)
#386 scenario title piece NR trait (png) replaced with a transparent svg piece image.
#387 (sub-issue within this alpha) Remove a test Alert from movement trigger in Counter Basics.
#388 Scenario title input help improved. Input box now cancels cleanly.
#388 Make it work for scenario starting template. Core scenarion piece & scenario base p/type check for scenarionName contains "HERE".
#389 Short cuts Control+[] removed from zoom tip text.
#391a LCC stats restored in diceTray (diceCase = 1 exit special case)
#392a Corrected spelling for movedHex in Movement Stop prototype (a12 only).

#398a Default action updates for markOrder & reset of Leader piece movedHex property.

#425 (& 419) Decline square required TC mkr bypass & undoFirstStrike limited to square decision phase (PBEM).

#396a (421 ) Reclaiming a card turns order updates off (avoiding spurious orders warnings).

#418a Correct error in battleMove moveCase (4) evaluation affecting all but Light Inf (gIsMelee inverted). Retreat (Retire) needed to clear gCombatSide also.

#446 Fix in Movement Stop & Movement Stop LT p/types to qualify setting of stopped property.

#406a Combat Assist-Take Ground - fix attack terrain fieldworks data passing
#447 Add stopped check to Cavalry Forward card & widget. Add Take Ground integration.

#451a Fix to Artillery movement - maxMove setting was absent.

#354a (422) Army Reporting Services must not retrieve Square card in case of Battalion Mass
#459a IF tracking from offboard in gOrders: (gOrdersLeft == 0 && baseMove > 0) then offboarding should return the order

#471 Hold the Line Leader needs to call chkAfterRetreat rather than flipSide. CiC variant also modified to work cleanly with HtLL.
#455 (472) gCombatSide retained when gCombatPhase set (3) && !gCAnotReady. In p/types Combat Assist-Retreats & CA-CiC Deferred Retreat Display

Strength + "+1" : (Strength+ccBonus)) + (ccMvMalus != 0 ? "" + (-ccMvMalus) + "" : "") + "" + (NoXSW ? "No Saber hits except on Leaders." : "") + GetProperty("tNote" + BasicName)}

{tCAV + BasicName + tBlockFmt + tBlock.repeat(Strength) + tNoBlockFont + tBlock.repeat(MaxStrength-Strength) + tHdgCAV +(BasicName.contains("Light") ? VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.faces: Command key reminders use symbols to represent modifiers: ⌃ Control\, ⇧ Shift\, ⌥ Alt or Option and ⎋ escape.,The number of remaining orders is displayed on the side's icon to the left of the board. If an error is indicated\, check the number orders and section used.,Orders are automatically generated where possible following Command card play. Elan and Rally rolls are evaluated too.,For best experience\, drag or right-click blocks from the edge of the piece. The central area will respond to left click with a default action (ordering or marking for combat).,Cursing those dice? Try Game Options...Report Game Stats or press ⇧F10 for some fun facts! Also available in the player aids window F1.,Want a count of lost blocks? Lost Blocks Display makes it easy! See Game Options or press F10.,Starting a PBEM game? For best experience\, switch to "offline" mode from the clickable connection icon or at any time from the Game Options dropdown menu. ,To apply hits manually after cancelling a hits marker\, left-click on the Attacker or Target marker.,Combat Assist: To apply hits\, click on the hits icon . To apply hits in lieu of retreats\, click on the red retreats icon .,Players can apply most combat commands without selecting the piece. Press F1 for the shortcuts help sheet.,Combat Assist: Clicking on a mandatory retreats icon applies the displayed number of hits. To retreat instead\, select the unit or stack and drag it from its right edge\, away from the flag icon.,Combat Assist: Clicking on an optional retreats icon ignores all flags. To retreat instead\, optionally ignore flags with a right-click menu command and retreat the required hexes.,The "Move First" player starts a game by clicking on the "Deal Cards" icon (left of game board).,Combat Assist: Clicking on a partly optional retreats icon ignores maximum possible flags and displays the required retreats. To ignore fewer flags\, use a right-click menu command.,If any Special game counters are missing\, these may be drawn from the Markers palette [F4] to form a stock on the player's side of the board.,Mother Russia: Drag a Paper Strength counter onto a valid hex to gain the benefit. Left-click to select the counter 's action at the location if need be.,Press F1 to pull up the charts window for official player aids and expansion rules. ,To show or hide your hand window\, press ⎋ (escape) or\, during a game\, click on your side's turn icon.,Simply press the Squaring button in your hand window to put your targeted infantry unit into square. For Battalion Mass\, click on your side's count of Battalion Mass markers.,Player Command Size and Tactician hand size are displayed on the Wellington and Napoleon icons to the left of the board.,Left-click on a counter store to draw or play a counter as applicable. [Preferences...Game Options: Mouse-Click Counter Actions],Command ⌃⇧H applies the currently pending hits determined by Combat Assist.,Hidden hotkeys ⌥Q and ⌥T will generate another Napoleon quote and module tip respectively.,Several features can be tailored to your needs via Preferences...Game Options tab\, or Settings... on MacOS from Ventura onwards.,Sound is optional and can be turned on or off for this module on the Preferences...Sounds tab.,Combat markers can be placed by drag and drop as well as by using the right-click menu or left-click on a piece.,End turn is fully automated through the "Draw & End Turn" button [F12]. Other Player Hand toolbar buttons are for special rules & corrections.,Hotkey F12 performs a normal end turn including all card handling. For special rules\, use options from the Player Hand.,The Help menu offers useful resources for playing the game and using this module.,To quickly zoom the game board to its window try the "fit" options under the magnifying glass toolbar button.,You can claim a Victory Banner by clicking on an empty banner space. Click on a Victory Banner to remove it. ,Game clocks keep approximate track of playing time in an online game. Press F8 to pause. Click on a clock to switch manually.,To detach a leader without marking the unit\, right-click on the leader piece and select the special command "Detach Leader" (shortcut: ⌥D).,Use left-arrow to access a unit and its right-click menu beneath an attached leader.,After playing a card\, left-click on the middle of a unit or its attached leader to order that unit. A further click will place an Attack marker. [Preferences...Game Options: Mouse-Click Battlefield Actions],During Orders phase\, if you accidentally place an Attack marker\, it will be removed automatically when you order or move an active piece.,Left-click on the middle of a unit or leader to place a combat marker. Attack markers are placed only on ordered units. [Preferences...Game Options: Mouse-Click Battlefield Actions],See Help...Module Reference Manual for a detailed user guide.,For best effect\, use Combat Assist to calculate dice\, apply hits\, Leader Check and retreats in sequence per rules. Nonetheless\, you can always roll a different number of dice or cancel results.,Mac user? ⌘ The command modifier key is synonomous with control for hotkeys (not for zoom or context menu shortcuts though).,The introductory tutorial demonstrates key features. See Help... from the main toolbar.,Combat actions can be performed via hotkeys with no piece selected. See shortcuts F1,Hotkeys F5 and ⌃C take the next Combat Assist action\, equivalent to clicking the Combat Assist widget.,If a unit is proving hard to mark for combat\, try dragging the appropriate marker onto it ⇧F5,A Help menu option takes you direct to the scenario's page on CommandsandColors.net. Why not record the result there at the end of your game?,If a mouseover obscures key information\, moving the pointer will display the tooltip in a different position.,Use the edge of a block piece to drag it or to access its context menu\, this avoids invoking the piece's left-click action.,If in doubt\, first check the Rules of Play\, FAQs & scenario page; see Help menu. If you find an anomaly\, please report it.,The Player Aids (F1) include a full iconography to help with using the module.,The "no entry" symbol indicates a prohibited move location.,To try "Point & Click" movement\, select Setup Movement Feature from Game Options prior to dealing cards. Test games only please.,For best movement tracking in Drag & Drop mode\, drag pieces from one hex to the next., The scenario database\, reference material and more is provided by commandsandcolors.net. Please donate to support the site when you can - see Help menu for link.,The Combat Assist widget (where combat dice appear) can be left-clicked by the applicable player to take the default combat action. The side-bar - including national flag - can be left-clicked for special options.,✅ Combat Assist battle confirmation mode eases chat-based play and can be set on or off in via Preferences...Game Options tab.
VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.name: Module Tips

VASSAL.build.module.RandomTextButton.faces: Sometimes the slightest circumstance decides the issue of a battle.,Doctors will have more lives to answer for in the next world than even we generals.,I love a brave soldier who has undergone the baptism of fire.,If you had seen one day of war\, you would pray to God that you would never see another.,In war\, no evil - even if it is permissible under the rules - is excusable unless it is absolutely necessary.,In war\, morale factors acount for three quarters of the whole; relative material strength accounts for only one quarter.,Remember \, gentlemen\, what a Roman emperor said: The corpse of an enemy always smells sweet.,There is a moment in every battle at which the least manoeuvre is decisive.,An army marches on its stomach.,An army's effectiveness depends on its size\, training\, experience\, and morale\, and morale is worth more than any of the other factors combined.,Between a battle lost and a battle won\, the distance is immense and there stand empires.,Courage is like love: it must have hope for nourishment.,Every soldier carries a marshal's baton in his pack.,God is on the side with the best artillery.,He that makes war without many mistakes has not made war very long.,How many things apparently impossible have nevertheless been performed by resolute men who had no alternative but death.,I have made all the calculations\, fate will do the rest.,If the art of war were nothing but the art of avoiding risks\, glory would become the prey of mediocre minds.,If they want peace\, nations should avoid the pin-pricks that precede cannonshots.,If you wage war\, do it energetically and with severity. This is the only way to make it shorter and consequently less inhuman.,In time of revolution\, with perseverance and courage\, a soldier should think nothing impossible.,In war there is but one favorable moment; the great art is to seize it!,In war\, three-quarters turns on personal character and relations; the balance of manpower and materials counts only for the remaining quarter.,It should not be believed that a march of three or four days in the wrong direction can be corrected by a countermarch. As a rule\, this is to make two mistakes instead of one.,One bad general is worth two good ones.,Read over and over the campaigns of Alexander\, Hannibal\, Caesar\, Gustavus\, Turenne\, Eugene and Frederic. This is the only way to become a great general.,Soldiers generally win battles; generals get credit for them.,Strategy is the art of making use of time and space. Space we can recover\, lost time never.,The armies of the Republic must feed themselves on war at the expense of the enemy territory.,The morale is to the physical as three to one.,The most important qualification of a soldier is fortitude under fatigue and privation. Courage is only second.,Hardship\, poverty and want are the best school for a soldier.,The secret of war lies in communications.,There are certain things in war of which the commander alone comprehends the importance.,Nothing but the commander's superior firmness and ability can subdue and surmount all difficulties.,There are many good generals\, but they see too many things at once. I see one thing\, namely the enemy's main body.,Try to crush the enemy's main body\, confident that secondary matters will settle themselves.,There are only two forces in the world\, the sword and the spirit. In the long run the sword will always be conquered by the spirit.,Once I have made up my mind\, everything is forgotten except what leads to success.,There is no man more pusillanimous than I when I am planning a campaign. I purposely exaggerate all the dangers and all the calamities that the circumstances make possible.,To have good soldiers\, a nation must always be at war.,Two armies are two bodies which meet and try to frighten each other.,Victory belongs to the most persevering.,What my enemies call a general peace is my destruction. What I call peace is merely the disarmament of my enemies. Am I not more moderate than they?,You do not get peace by shouting: Peace. Peace is a meaningless word; what we need is a glorious peace.,You must not fight too often with one enemy\, or you will teach him all your art of war.,A general-in-chief should ask\, What should I do if the enemy appeared now in my front\, or on my right\, or on my left?,A rapid march increases all the chances of victory.,When an army is inferior in number\, in cavalry and in artillery\, it is essential to avoid a general action.,If you want to avoid a battle with a superior army\, occupy a good defensive position.,The transition from defensive to offensive is one of the most delicate operations in war.,As far as possible\, the artillery should cover and command the surrounding country.,When you are resolved to fight a battle\, collect your whole force. A single battalion sometimes decides the day.,When you determine to risk a battle\, reserve to yourself every possible chance of success.,Never leave gaps for the enemy to penetrate\, unless it be to draw him into a snare.,Encampments of the same army should be formed so as to protect each other.,Infantry\, cavalry and artillery are nothing without each other.,It is the business of cavalry to follow up the victory\, and to prevent the beaten army from rallying.,Artillery is more essential to cavalry than to infantry\, because cavalry has no fire for its defence.,Artillery should be placed in the most advantageous positions\, as far in front of the cavalry and infantry\, without comprising the safety of the guns\, as possible.,It depends on the general alone to conquer difficulties by superior talent and resolution.,The science of strategy is only to be acquired by experience\, and by studying the campaigns of all the great captains.,Once the offensive has been assumed\, it must be sustained to the last.,To advance or not to advance is a matter for grave consideration.,Even in offensive warfare in the open field the great secret consists in defensive combats\, and in obliging the enemy to attack.,It is an approved maxim in war\, never to do what the enemy wishes you to do.,Nothing is so important in war as an undivided command.,Never interrupt your enemy when he is making a mistake.,The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos\, both his own and the enemy’s.,Give me lucky generals.,Fear and uncertainty accelerate the fall of empires.,In war\, chance is half of everything.,More battles are lost by loss of hope than loss of blood.,Winning is not enough if one doesn’t take advantage of success.

VASSAL.build.module.properties.GlobalTra.description: Display text for stats help button
VASSAL.build.module.properties.GlobalTra.initialValue:
The Game Stats display provides a summary of data gathered during the game, much of it from the Combat Assist feature. A few points on terminology used in the stats report:
    • Dice "hits luck" is assessed as hits rolled as a percentage relative to expected.
    • Combined Arms is categorised as an Infantry or Cavalry attack.
    • A “Return Melee” is a battle round following a normal attack or a “First Strike”-type event.
    • The Tactician card Charge if Charged is reported as a First Strike.
    • Retreat Losses are reported separately from losses due to hits.
    The display is updated at turn end and when a change in Victory Banners occurs. Manual refresh is available from the toolbar and the report can be sent to chat.
VASSAL.build.module.properties.GlobalTra.name: mStatsHelp
